title: Phase 2: domain vocabulary session (vidhi-domain)
description:
One vidhi-domain session to sharpen vocabulary across all layers of the sutra architectural model. Terms like "component," "convention," "constraint," "verification" need precise definitions — they'll appear in every PRD, API, and tool name.

Input: docs/sutra-vision.md (the seven-layer model)
Output: shared domain vocabulary with precise definitions
execution_record: Domain vocabulary session covering 16 terms across core model, rules/patterns, provenance, trust model, core loop verbs, and artifacts. Created CONTEXT.md with glossary, relationships, example dialogue, and flagged ambiguities. One ADR (sketch mode affects conventions only, not constraints).
